chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

Take wisdom from wherever it may be, for indeed wisdom resides in the bosom of the hypocrite, so it flutters in his chest until it emerges and settles with its companions in the bosom of the believer.
ai.seo_question: Why should we take wisdom from hypocrites according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) advises taking wisdom from any source, even a hypocrite, because wisdom is a distinct quality that can reside in the chest of a hypocrite. It remains there until it is extracted and settles among the believers, indicating that the presence of wisdom in a person does not necessarily reflect their overall faith or sincerity. This concept, known as 'wisdom in the chest of the hypocrite,' highlights the objective nature of knowledge (hikmah) separate from the moral character of its possessor, a key theme in Shia epistemology regarding the discernment of truth regardless of the speaker's piety.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 79. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:

Take wise points from wherever they may be, because if a wise saying is in the bosom of a hypocrite it flutters in his bosom till it comes out and settles with others of its own category in the bosom of the believer.
